name: Positional & Normal-Based Voxel Shadowing
definition: Calculates a per-face shadow multiplier using block position, block type, and face normal to simulate directional shading without ray tracing.
summary: Positional & Normal-Based Voxel Shadowing calculates per-face shadow multipliers using deterministic rules based on block position and face normal, avoiding expensive ray tracing to simulate directional shading.
